os_list.name: Jellyby (Raspberry Pi 4)
os_list.description: Kiosk launcher for Emby / Jellyfin / Plex controlled with your HDMI-CEC projector remote, plus a readsb ADS-B receiver. SSH enabled, default login pi / jellyby (change it after first boot).

images.name: Jellyby Pi 4 (64-bit)
images.description: Ready-to-flash Jellyby image based on Raspberry Pi OS Lite. Boots straight into the kiosk; SSH enabled (pi / jellyby).
